title: How a P-Trap Retains Water to Block Sewer Air
description: The P-trap is a fundamental component of sink drainage designed to maintain a persistent liquid barrier known as the trap seal. Every time water flows down the fixture drain, it sweeps away waste while leaving behind fresh water in the lower dip of the pipe. This trapped water forms a complete physical seal against gases originating in the sewer or septic system. Understanding how gravity and trap geometry work together ensures correct assembly during sink drain installations.
